resources.string: Scroll any app with your S Pen button

Pen Scroll only performs a single swipe gesture on the screen when you trigger \"Scroll Down\" or \"Scroll Up\" (for example from S Pen Air actions). It does not read, store or send any screen content. If you turn on the volume-key option, it also turns volume up/down into scrolls while Instagram is open.
Turn on Pen Scroll in Accessibility settings
Samsung may stop the service in the background. Turn off battery optimization.
How far the finger travels, as a share of the screen height
Raise this if the swipe lands before the app underneath is back
Fallback for when Air actions send volume up/down. Overrides volume keys while Instagram is open.
Tap a button, then switch to Instagram within 3 seconds.

string-array.name: setup_steps
string-array.item: Android 13+ blocks Accessibility for sideloaded apps. Go to Settings > Apps > Pen Scroll > three-dot menu (top right) > \"Allow restricted settings\".
Settings > Accessibility > Installed apps > Pen Scroll > turn on.
Settings > Apps > Pen Scroll > Battery > Unrestricted (so Samsung doesn\'t kill it).
Settings > Advanced features > S Pen > Air actions > Press and hold Pen button > choose \"Scroll Down\".
If the gesture slots under Anywhere actions accept apps, assign one to \"Scroll Down\" and one to \"Scroll Up\".
